subject: history
title: Stone Age to Iron Age
description: Changes in Britain from the Stone Age to the Iron Age: hunter-gatherers and early farmers, Bronze Age technology and monuments, and Iron Age hill forts and tribes.

objectives.statement: Understand the change from late Neolithic hunter-gatherers to early farmers, for example Skara Brae.
Describe Bronze Age religion, technology and travel, for example Stonehenge and the use of metal.
Describe Iron Age hill forts, tribal kingdoms, farming, art and culture.
Understand how we find out about prehistory from archaeology and artefacts, and place the periods on a timeline.
